title: Evidence Tri-State & Capture-Proof Ref Identity Resolution

claims.assertion: Accessibility properties must adhere to an Evidence Tri-State (Known, Absent, Unknown) without collapsing to boolean. Element refs (@snapshot_id:eN) are proven unique across the entire window at snapshot time using 16 field-mask buckets and unread_bits verification.

distilled_learning: Operating system accessibility trees exhibit partial reads, timing glitches, and identical twins. agent-desktop resolves this by enforcing a non-collapsing Evidence Tri-State (Known, Absent, Unknown) and whole-window CaptureProof. When an element is captured, its uniqueness is verified across the window under a 16 field-mask bucket index. If unread_bits exist (a property timed out or failed to read), uniqueness is withheld, preventing false-positive ref actions and eliminating non-deterministic click delivery.
